MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE a.fileName IN jars AND NOT t:Inner AND t.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.pulsar.' AND NOT t.fqn CONTAINS '$'

RETURN t.fqn, count(DISTINCT s) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12
